name: Website / Web App Build
description: Full build cycle from discovery to launch for a client website or web application

parameters.label: Current Status / What exists
parameters.placeholder: e.g. existing Express site to migrate, starting fresh, has design mockups

parameters.label: Key Features Required
parameters.placeholder: e.g. job management, estimate builder, client portal, payments

steps.task: Research and discovery for {{project_name}} ({{project_type}}) for {{client_name}}. Review: {{current_status}}. Investigate: comparable tools/sites in the industry, best practices for {{project_type}}, UX patterns, integration options, and any existing codebase or design assets. Key features needed: {{key_features}}.

Design the full technical architecture for {{project_name}}. Stack: {{tech_stack}}. Type: {{project_type}}. Features: {{key_features}}. Produce: component tree, data model, API route plan, auth strategy, deployment approach, and a phased build plan with milestones. Flag any risks or constraints from current state: {{current_status}}.

Create the UX/UI design plan for {{project_name}} ({{project_type}}) for {{client_name}}. Define: page structure, navigation flow, key screen wireframes, component library, color/typography system, and responsive behavior. Prioritize the user flows for: {{key_features}}.

Begin implementation of {{project_name}} using {{tech_stack}}. Follow the architecture plan. Build the core scaffolding, routing, auth, and the highest-priority features: {{key_features}}. Document what was built, what's next, and any blockers. Current state context: {{current_status}}.

QA review of {{project_name}} build progress. Test: {{key_features}}. Check for: broken flows, missing error handling, mobile responsiveness, accessibility issues, and security concerns. Provide a prioritized bug report and pass/fail status for each feature.

Generate a build status report for {{project_name}} for client {{client_name}}. Summarize: what's been built, what's in progress, what's remaining, current blockers, estimated completion, and recommended next sprint priorities.
